cases.input: Let me interactively pick one of the failing test files to debug.
cases.context: A TTY session; a command producing the failing-file list exists.
expected: Pipes the candidate list into fzf as an interactive picker (fzf reads the piped stdin stream)
Uses the selected line as the follow-up command's argument
forbidden: Prints the list and asks the user to type a filename manually when fzf is available and a TTY is present
cases.rubric: PASS iff the flow is `<producer> | fzf` with the selection consumed downstream.

cases.input: Add that file-picking step to the CI script.
expected: Recognizes fzf requires a TTY and degrades to a non-interactive batch selection (e.g. `--filter` mode or a deterministic head/match) in CI, per the skill's degrade-gracefully clause
forbidden: Emits an interactive fzf invocation into a CI script where it would hang or fail
cases.rubric: PASS iff the CI variant is non-interactive and deterministic, with the TTY constraint stated.
